title.en: The smart oven and its core probe: the kofta recipe, the ladder, the limit

goal.en: The kofta recipe ends its bake when the core probe reads 71 degC. The oven preset has an oven thermometer and a core probe. See which rung the dry run records, what a probe alone would verify, and the limit the number comes from.

note.en: The bake step's end condition is the core probe at 71 degC or more, marked as a critical control point.
The oven preset lists both sensors.

The dry run records the first rung of the bake ladder, the oven thermometer; the end condition and the limit are the probe's job during the run. The preheat is a logged estimate because cw.op.heat's ladder names a pan thermometer, not an oven one.
An oven with only a core probe would still verify baking: the probe is the second rung.
The 71 degC in the recipe is the default limit for ground meat; the device asks a person when it is not reached.

cli: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:7878/v1/tools/ladder -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"op": "cw.op.bake", "sensors": ["cw.sense.core_temp"], "allowModel": true, "humanPresent": false}'

outcome.en: You know how a recipe, a sensor list and a limits pack meet on one number. You also saw a vocabulary edge: an oven preheat written as cw.op.heat is verified by estimate because that operation's ladder is pan-centred.
